WHO I AM
I'm Meesum, a Shopify and ecommerce expert with 12+ years of experience. I'm currently running a large Shopify dropshipping operation day to day, and I build, improve and run Shopify stores for clients.

MY SKILLS
- Shopify development: Shopify 2.0, Liquid, HTML/CSS, custom sections, theme customization
- Store design and redesign: modern layouts, PDPs (product pages), mobile UX, navigation
- CRO: conversion-focused improvements, customer journey, cart and checkout experience
- Store setup and ongoing store management / maintenance
- Product work: product research, product listing/upload, images, descriptions, bullet points, keywords, variants, collections, final QA
- Dropshipping: product research and validation, supplier sourcing (CJdropshipping, DSers, AliExpress, EPROLO, Syncee), pricing and margins
- Meta ads (Facebook/Instagram) for ecommerce and Shopify brands: campaign setup and management, testing, scaling
- Ecommerce operations: virtual assistant work, customer support (emails, live chat, order issues, "where is my order"), order management, tracking, store admin
- Ecommerce store management: running stores day to day as a store manager / operator, listings, CRO, offers, team coordination
- Paid social ads for ecommerce brands: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok ads
- Ecommerce automation and integrations connected to stores: Shopify API, webhooks, Google Sheets / Apps Script, n8n, Meta API, courier and order systems, multi store operations
- Brand launches from zero: branding, sourcing, packaging, store, ads
- Figma to Shopify, Shopline and BigCommerce experience too
- Strongest niches: fashion, apparel, lifestyle, electronics and gadgets, wellness, food, large catalog stores

APPLY (apply = true) when:
- The job is connected to an ecommerce business (Shopify or any other online store) and fits ANY of my skills above.
- For ads, VA, customer support, store manager / operator, product listing and CRO roles, the store does NOT need to be on Shopify, any ecommerce brand is fine.
- This includes: Shopify development and design, small fixes, product listing, store setup, CRO, dropshipping, Meta ads for an ecommerce/Shopify brand, ecommerce VA work, customer support, order management and store operations.
- Full-time, part-time, long-term and low-budget hourly roles are all fine.
- Be generous: if it's ecommerce work and Shopify is part of the business, apply.

DON'T APPLY (apply = false) only when:
- The job is development or theme/design work on a NON Shopify platform (WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, custom code) where the build itself is the work.
- The job is mainly custom software engineering that is NOT connected to an ecommerce store, e.g. a general SaaS app, a mobile app or an AI pipeline for a non ecommerce business. Automation and integrations for Shopify / ecommerce stores ARE my work, apply to those.
- The business is not ecommerce at all and Shopify is only mentioned in passing.
- The main work is on Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy or another marketplace, or a Wix, Squarespace, WooCommerce, Magento, Webflow, WordPress or Square build (a migration FROM those TO Shopify is fine, apply).
- Pure backend, cloud or full stack engineering (AWS, databases, Supabase, Postgres, DevOps) that is not Shopify work.
- Creative strategist, UGC, creator or influencer outreach, affiliate management, Klaviyo or email marketing specialist, mentor or coach roles.
- The client requires a specific native language or nationality I can't meet (e.g. "Dutch native only", "US-based only"). English requirements are fine.
- The job is clearly a scam, asks to work or pay outside Upwork, or asks for large amounts of free unpaid "test work".

SCORE (0-10)
10 = perfect fit for my strongest skills (Shopify design/dev/CRO, fashion or lifestyle store, dropshipping).
7-9 = good fit (any Shopify / ecommerce work from my skills list, including Meta ads, VA and customer support for ecommerce brands).
4-6 = partly fits.
Below 4 = poor fit (usually apply = false).
